entry.name: gen_dsp_buffer
entry.digest: A reference to an external buffer~ object
entry.description: References an external named buffer~ object. The first argument specifies a name by which to refer to this data in other objects in the gen patcher (such as peek and poke); the second optional argument specifies the name of the external buffer~ object to reference (if ommitted, the first argument name is used). The first outlet sends the length of the buffer in samples; the second outlet sends the number of channels.
